project_branches.purpose: implementation branch for the sample DocChange

demo_steps.command: python neodev.py product create --product-code NEODEV-DEMO --name "NeoDev Demo Product" --json
python neodev.py product version create --product-code NEODEV-DEMO --version-name V1.0 --json
python neodev.py product version bind-branch --product-code NEODEV-DEMO --version-name V1.0 --project-id 1 --branch main --json
python neodev.py product version bind-branch --product-code NEODEV-DEMO --version-name V1.0 --project-id 1 --branch feature/docchange-demo --json
python neodev.py doc scan --product-code NEODEV-DEMO --version-name V1.0 --root examples/neodev-rd-knowledge/doc-repo --json
python neodev.py doc change register --document-id <document_id> --doc-change-id DC-NEODEV-DEMO-001 --json
python neodev.py git verify-doc-change --project-id 1 --branch feature/docchange-demo --commit-sha <commit_sha> --commit-message "feat: update demo service\n\nDocChange-ID: DC-NEODEV-DEMO-001" --json
